messages:
alex: Heads up — AcmeCorp (acme-prod-01) is seeing a burst of 429s and pod evictions in their dedicated pool dced-42 between 11:20-11:35 UTC. They say traffic didn't spike. I can see rate-limiter tripping and autoscaler didn't react quickly. @maria @jordan can you triage?

maria: On it. Which pool and customer again? Any recent plan/quota changes?

alex: pool=dced-42, tenant=acme-prod-01. They moved plans last week (standard -> enterprise). Billing shows quota increase but API/logs still show low units. Suspect quota store mismatch.

jordan: grabbing logs now. Quick snippet from rate-limiter:
```
[2026-03-17T11:21:03Z] RateLimiter block tenant=acme-prod-01 key=tenant:acme-prod-01 allowed=60 window=60s used=61 action=429
[2026-03-17T11:21:04Z] autoscaler: queued 120 requests backlog=300 scale_action=none reason=min_reached
```
Looks like limiter thinks they're 60/min but billing says 600/min.

sam: I queried the quota service:
```sql
SELECT tenant, unit_type, units FROM quotas WHERE tenant='acme-prod-01';
-- returns: ('acme-prod-01', 'minute', '60')
```
UI/billing show 600/min. Migration history shows plan upgrade last Tue.

maria: Possible root causes: migration script converted hours->minutes incorrectly or a decimal truncation. Immediate mitigation options: 1) temporary tenant override, 2) scale pool manually, 3) route to hosted fallback for critical routes.

alex: Can we push an override while we investigate? @jordan you have quota-admin access right?

jordan: I'll apply a short override. Running admin command:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas/override \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-prod-01","units":600,"unit_type":"minute","ttl_seconds":3600}'
```
Applying now...

deploy-bot: autoscaler triggered scale dced-42 from 2 -> 4 replicas (reason: manual scale request by jordan).

jordan: Override applied and confirmed in quota store. Rate-limiter logs now:
```
[2026-03-17T11:22:12Z] RateLimiter allow tenant=acme-prod-01 allowed=600 used=120
```
Customer reports 429s dropping.

support_lead: Customer update — error rate dropped from ~22% to ~0.7%. They still see some latency spikes while autoscaler finishes warmup. Recommended to set min_replicas=4 for this pool for next 24h.

sam: Created infra issue: infra/quotas#1234 — migration script incorrectly divided by 60 when converting hourly->minute units (bad factor). PR: https://git.redwood/infra/quotas/pull/987

maria: Post-incident actions: 1) revert faulty migration, 2) add unit conversion sanity tests, 3) add alert if billing UI and quota-store diverge by >20%, 4) make override API require audit tag + faster propagation path.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll communicate to Acme support contact and keep thread open for 24h. :thumbsup:

jordan: Leaving a short repro for oncall — to reproduce: create tenant with units=1 hour, run migration script with bad factor, then watch rate-limiter interpreting units as minute. Logs above.

sam: Noted. I'll monitor and roll out fix this afternoon.

maria: Closing loop once infra/quotas#1234 merges and we confirm stable metrics for 24h.

alex: Great. Marking as customer-impacting and adding to weekly postmortem agenda.
